lines.d1: It works on my machine, but breaks on the server, because the environment is different.
lines.d2: A Docker image packs the app together with its runtime, libraries and settings.
lines.d3: Run an image and you get a container: an isolated process with its own files and network.
lines.d4: Containers share the host kernel, so they start in milliseconds and are far lighter than virtual machines.
lines.d5: Images are built in layers, so unchanged layers are cached and shared between images.
lines.d6: Ship the same image to a laptop, a test server or the cloud, and it runs the same way everywhere.
